character: Small traditional hamlet of chalets and converted barns at 1,400m. Quiet, peaceful, family-friendly. Own shops, bakery, supermarket, bars, restaurants. High-speed chairlift to Altiport ski area. Free bus to Méribel Centre. Blue run returns to village.
dining: Local restaurants with sunny terraces. Bars, bakery.
shopping: Small supermarket, bakery, sports rental shops, bars.
apres_scene: Quiet village atmosphere with a few local bars. Terrace dining in sun.
activities_nearby: Chairlift to Altiport ski area (gentle blue run returns). Free shuttle to Méribel Centre Parc Olympique. Hiking, snowshoeing. 5-min drive/bus to Méribel Centre.
